summary: Iteration 7: full backend + frontend verification of (A) Remediation KPI Strip, (B) Policy History, (C) AI Agent Governance (kernel-native app with red-team + kernel composition), and Enterprise Access (Connectors / SSO/SAML / SCIM / ABAC). 24/24 pytest cases pass; UI selectors all resolve for both admin and operational personas; kernel composition verified (red-team on AGT-002 with all guardrails off => score 0, spawns remediation workflow subject=AGT-002 AND creates agent_risk notification; hardening all four guardrails => score 100). Operational RBAC verified: 403 on PATCH /agents, POST /agents/redteam, PUT /enterprise/sso, POST /enterprise/abac, GET /policies/{id}/history; nav-enterprise & nav-platform-kernel hidden in sidebar; guardrail toggle buttons render disabled. External integrations behave as MOCKED (deterministic seed, no real IdP/cloud). Cleanup executed at end.
critical_code_review_comments: kernel/policy.py `history()` returns docs shaped {policy_id, changes:[{field,from,to}], by, at} (grouped per-PATCH). The task spec described per-field records {field,from,to,by,at}. Frontend PolicyModal already consumes the grouped shape so UI is fine, but consider aligning docs/spec with implementation to avoid ambiguity.
backend/enterprise.py toggle_scim: `last_provisioned` is hardcoded to 42 when enabled; acceptable for MOCKED demo but should be documented.
agents.py: create_agent uses `counter['seq'] + 3` to produce ref suffix — assumes seed of 3 agents. If seed list ever changes, refs collide. Consider using max(existing ref suffix)+1.
notifications.create uses `kind` field (not `type`); tests/spec used `type` term. Consistent naming would help API consumers.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — test created and cleaned up ABAC-*, patched policies restored (POL-CTRL-DRIFT threshold 8), AGT-002 guardrails reset to all-false, last_redteam cleared on all agents, remediation workflows for AGT-002 removed, agent_risk notifications removed, enterprise_config deleted, connectors reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter7_agents_enterprise.py is stable and idempotent (self-cleans). Notification field name is `kind` not `type`. Frontend `agent-redteam` button only renders for admin role (operational only sees read-only modal without Run button). Escape key or overlay-click closes agent-modal (sticky-header interception with close-X is a known non-bug per iteration note).
